svg.title: Ornith 1.5 MixedCal-v2 on Intel Arc Pro B70 — self-reported C1 card
svg.desc: Client post-first decode and cold-input rates for Ornith MixedCal-v2 GPTQ INT4 on one Intel Arc Pro B70. Default serve is MTP1 plus DraftINT4. MTP4 is slower than no-spec. Self-reported E2. LocalMaxxing APPROVED means accepted self-report, not independent reproduction.
svg.text: INTEL ARC PRO B70 · vLLM XPU
GPTQ INT4 G128 experts-only · default MTP1 + DraftINT4 · C1 · cache off
230 W is configured cap. Combined MTP prefill ≠ no-spec 9.7k (first token in TTFT).
paired A/B p2048 @230 W no-spec (3-round med)
APPROVED = accepted self-report, not independent reproduction
Image digest f01e24f6 · 0.27.2rc1.dev77+gac7509e2b · kernels 0.1.12.3 · XPU WNA16 (int_wna16)
client SSE post-first · cold input = endpoint tokens / client TTFT
MixedCal-v2 RTN 10.37% (3186/30720) vs WikiText 24.76%. Speed at 150 W is parity, not a MixedCal tok/s win.
Default serve: MTP1 + DraftINT4. MTP4 is slower than no-spec. Prefill lever is configured 230 W (~9.7k no-spec), not MixedCal.
Combined tokSPrefill 9073 includes MTP first-token work inside TTFT, so it is not the no-spec 9780 cell.
Self-reported E2 with raw evidence · not independently reproduced · greedy diagnostic · C1 only
